about: The Workbench icons of the Iceball drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/iceball.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a voxel island of grass and earth in a blue sea, a blue soldier on its peak throwing a grenade at a green one) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/iceball.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Iceball-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Iceball.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Iceball.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, the licence files and README-Iceball.txt; Data.info is the icon of the data drawers (pkg, clsave, svsave, docs, Libs).
